//| echo: true
{
  // Front-facing 20 mm tag, fixed camera, translation in the L frame.
  const camera = {width: 1280, height: 1080, focalPx: 880, depthM: 0.55};
  const secondsPerImage = 0.1;
  const xrHz = 90;
  const positionsMm = [
    [-302, -70], [-260, -55], [-200, -30], [-120, 6], [-27, 40],
    [75, 63], [182, 72], [285, 62], [162, 17], [47, -20],
    [-43, -47], [-105, -58], [-140, -54], [-155, -35], [-153, -9]
  ];
  const positions = positionsMm.map(pair => pair.map(mm => mm / 1000));
  const pixelsPerMetre = camera.focalPx / camera.depthM;
  const edgePx = 0.020 * pixelsPerMetre;
  const project = ([x, y]) => [
    camera.width / 2 + pixelsPerMetre * x,
    camera.height / 2 - pixelsPerMetre * y
  ];

  // Moving, uncoupled tag at full confidence. Each step uses only past observations.
  const displayAlpha = 1 - Math.exp(-38 / xrHz);
  let display = positions[0].slice();
  let velocity = [0, 0];
  const forecasts = positions.slice(0, -1).map((position, index) => {
    if (index > 0) {
      const raw = position.map((p, axis) => (p - positions[index - 1][axis]) / secondsPerImage);
      const limit = 1.8 / Math.max(1.8, Math.hypot(...raw));
      const reversed = raw[0] * velocity[0] + raw[1] * velocity[1] < 0;
      const weight = reversed ? 1 : 0.58;
      velocity = raw.map((v, axis) => (1 - weight) * velocity[axis] + weight * v * limit);
    }
    const speed = Math.hypot(...velocity);
    for (let tick = 1; tick <= secondsPerImage * xrHz; tick++) {
      const age = tick / xrHz;
      const decay = Math.exp(-Math.max(0, age - 0.12) / 0.085);
      const lead = speed < 0.015 ? 0 : Math.min(0.105, 0.72 * age) * decay;
      display = position.map((p, axis) => {
        const predicted = p + velocity[axis] * lead;
        return display[axis] + displayAlpha * (predicted - display[axis]);
      });
    }
    const center = project(display);
    const half = Math.min(240, Math.max(110, Math.round(2.2 * edgePx + Math.min(130, 165 * speed))));
    const box = [
      Math.max(0, Math.floor(center[0] - half)), Math.max(0, Math.floor(center[1] - half)),
      Math.min(camera.width, Math.ceil(center[0] + half)), Math.min(camera.height, Math.ceil(center[1] + half))
    ];
    return {center, box, speed};
  });

  const german = document.documentElement.lang.startsWith("de");
  const labels = german ? {
    capture: "Letzte bekannte Aufnahme",
    trail: "Optische Spur",
    centre: "Suchmitte",
    next: "Tag im Folgebild",
    speed: "Geschätztes Tempo",
    window: "Suchfenster",
    share: "Anteil am Bild"
  } : {
    capture: "Last observed frame",
    trail: "Observed trail",
    centre: "Search centre",
    next: "Tag in next frame",
    speed: "Estimated speed",
    window: "Search window",
    share: "Share of image"
  };
  const panel = html`<div class="roi-demo">
    <label for="roi-frame">${labels.capture} <output for="roi-frame"></output></label>
    <input id="roi-frame" type="range" min="2" max="${forecasts.length}" step="1" value="7">
    <div class="roi-body">
      <div class="roi-view"></div>
      <div>
        <ul class="roi-legend">
          <li><i aria-hidden="true" style="color:#006d70">●</i>${labels.trail}</li>
          <li><i aria-hidden="true" style="color:#944c12">✚</i>${labels.centre}</li>
          <li><i aria-hidden="true" style="color:#423780">□</i>${labels.next}</li>
        </ul>
        <dl>
          <div><dt>${labels.speed}</dt><dd class="roi-speed"></dd></div>
          <div><dt>${labels.window}</dt><dd class="roi-size"></dd></div>
          <div><dt>${labels.share}</dt><dd class="roi-share"></dd></div>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="roi-status" role="status"></p>
  </div>`;
  const slider = panel.querySelector("input");
  const pixels = positions.map(project);
  const format = (value, digits) => value.toLocaleString(german ? "de-DE" : "en-GB", {minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits});
  function draw() {
    const frame = slider.valueAsNumber;
    const {center, box, speed} = forecasts[frame - 1];
    const trail = pixels.slice(0, frame);
    const [lastX, lastY] = trail[trail.length - 1];
    const [u, v] = center;
    const [nextX, nextY] = pixels[frame];
    const [left, top, right, bottom] = box;
    const width = right - left, height = bottom - top;
    const inside = nextX - edgePx / 2 >= left && nextX + edgePx / 2 <= right
      && nextY - edgePx / 2 >= top && nextY + edgePx / 2 <= bottom;
    const dots = trail.map(([x, y]) => svg`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="9" fill="#006d70"/>`);
    const frameLabel = `${german ? "Bild" : "Frame"} ${frame} → ${frame + 1}`;
    panel.querySelector("output").textContent = frameLabel;
    slider.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", frameLabel);
    panel.querySelector(".roi-view").replaceChildren(svg`<svg class="roi-image" viewBox="0 0 1280 1080"
        role="img" aria-label="${frameLabel}. ${labels.trail}, ${labels.window}, ${labels.next}.">
      <rect width="1280" height="1080" fill="#edf3f4"/>
      <path d="M320 0V1080 M640 0V1080 M960 0V1080 M0 270H1280 M0 540H1280 M0 810H1280"
            stroke="#d1dfe1" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
      <rect x="${left}" y="${top}" width="${width}" height="${height}"
            fill="#dfaa68" fill-opacity=".25" stroke="#944c12" stroke-width="6"/>
      <polyline points="${trail.map(p => p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="#006d70" stroke-width="6"/>
      ${dots}
      <path d="M${lastX} ${lastY} L${u} ${v}" stroke="#944c12" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="9 7"/>
      <circle cx="${lastX}" cy="${lastY}" r="13" fill="#006d70" stroke="white" stroke-width="4"/>
      <path d="M-16 0H16 M0 -16V16" transform="translate(${u} ${v})" stroke="#944c12" stroke-width="7"/>
      <rect x="${nextX - edgePx / 2}" y="${nextY - edgePx / 2}" width="${edgePx}" height="${edgePx}"
            fill="none" stroke="#423780" stroke-width="7"/>
    </svg>`);
    panel.querySelector(".roi-speed").textContent = `${format(speed, 2)} m/s`;
    panel.querySelector(".roi-size").textContent = `${width} × ${height} px`;
    panel.querySelector(".roi-share").textContent = `${format(100 * width * height / (camera.width * camera.height), 1)} %`;
    const status = german
      ? [`In Bild ${frame + 1} liegen alle vier Tagecken im Suchfenster.`,
         `In Bild ${frame + 1} liegt der Tag nach der Umkehr außerhalb des Suchfensters.`]
      : [`All four tag corners are inside the search window in frame ${frame + 1}.`,
         `After the reversal, the tag falls outside the search window in frame ${frame + 1}.`];
    panel.querySelector(".roi-status").textContent = status[inside ? 0 : 1];
  }
  slider.addEventListener("input", draw);
  draw();
  return panel;
}
